units.source_text: 驹子说着，俯下刚梳理好的头，去拨弄被炉里的炭火。

en.t: Komako said this, lowering her freshly arranged hair as she stirred the charcoal fire in the kotatsu.

units.source_text: 她还告诉岛村：病人患肠结核，是回家乡等死的。

en.t: She also told Shimamura that the sick man had intestinal tuberculosis and had gone back to his hometown to wait for death.
